name: Kuroyagi Maria
source:
"Nufufu... At long last, the final hour dawns. The momentous occasion for me to be sacrificed upon the stage of despair has finally arrived. Come, then! Cast the die, Make your choice! Choose me!"

An unsettling girl, who longs for death, in the midst of a ceremony aimed for survival. For a certain reason, she has come to believe in the philosophy that 'death is salvation'. She always speaks in an extravagant and theatrical manner, exaggerating her words. she fervently awaits the moment at which she can finally experience the gruesome, hideous, and beautiful death which she longs for.

Flower: Silver Lace
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [???]

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Maria_Kuroyagi]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
